// Fan out: one item per queued video row { id, url, status, ... }
return (($json.videos) || []).map(v => ({ json: v }));

assignments.name: transcript
assignments.value: =REPLACE — wire a YouTube-transcript node here and output the transcript TEXT into this field. Video URL: {{ $json.url }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You extract trading-strategy logic from a video transcript into STRICT JSON. If the transcript is empty or still contains the word REPLACE, respond ONLY with {"error":"transcript not provided"}. Otherwise extract ONLY what is explicitly stated or strongly implied — do NOT invent rules, hidden edge, timeframes, or profitability claims. Return JSON with keys: strategy_name, market, timeframe, indicators (array of strings), entry_conditions (array), exit_conditions (array), risk_management (object: risk_per_trade, rr_ratio), strategy_type (one of: scalping, intraday, swing, options, trend-following, mean-reversion, smc, ict, volatility). Leave a field empty if the video does not state it.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.transcript } ] }) }}
